motions.purpose: Guide attention across eight real cities: the globe rotates each city to face the camera, draws the great-circle route, and shows name, country, and exact coordinates.
motions.model: City positions use real WGS84 coordinates mapped onto the textured sphere; routes are geometric great circles; flight timing and camera choreography are presentational.
motions.limitations: Tour pacing, camera moves, and route lift are presentation choices; the terminator position follows the scene's fixed sun, not the current date and time.
motions.reducedMotion: İstanbul faces the camera immediately; no flights, no auto-advance; coordinates remain readable.
motions.exportState: Freeze with city index 0 facing the camera, satellite at a fixed phase, stars hidden per export policy, controls hidden.
motions.accessibility: Native buttons drive the tour; N advances, Escape ends the tour, Space pauses rotation; the caption reports city name, country, and coordinates as text.

motions.purpose: Add scale and motion context: a small spacecraft circles on a 51.6-degree-inclined orbit with a fading trail.
motions.model: Circular inclined orbit computed analytically for display; radius and period chosen for legibility, not physics.
motions.limitations: Not a real ephemeris: altitude, period, and ground track are illustrative; no perturbations or attitude dynamics.
motions.reducedMotion: Satellite renders at a fixed orbital phase with its trail visible.
motions.exportState: Satellite frozen at phase 1.2 rad with deterministic trail.
motions.accessibility: The satellite is decorative context; all information it suggests is restated as text in the caption.
